## Complete Chronological 12-Stadium Game-by-Game Itinerary

### Stop 1: ES CON FIELD HOKKAIDO (Kitahiroshima / Sapporo, Hokkaido)
* **Date:** Tuesday, June 23, 2026
* **Matchup:** Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters vs. Chiba Lotte Marines (13:00 Day Game)
* **Stadium:** ES CON FIELD HOKKAIDO — NPB's newest retractable-roof stadium (opened 2023) featuring natural turf, an on-site craft brewery, and hot spring views.
* **Travel Leg:** Arrival at Sapporo New Chitose Airport (CTS) → JR Rapid Airport train to Kitahiroshima Station (20 min, ¥540 / ~$3.60), then 5-min shuttle to F Village (¥200 / ~$1.30).
* **Accommodation:** **tower eleven hotel** (Booking.com score: 9.1 Wonderful, inside the stadium) or **Kitahiroshima Classe Hotel** (score: 7.3 Good, 0.5 mi from station with free shuttle, ~$95/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Ballpark:* Soratoshiba craft beer brewed inside the stadium with Hokkaido wagyu skewers and milk soft-serve on the concourse.
  * *Dinner (Susukino):* Rich Shinshu miso ramen at **Ramen Shingen Minami-6jo** or **Ganso Ramen Yokocho** (Susukino Ramen Alley); follow up with Genghis Khan (charcoal-grilled mutton BBQ) at **Daruma 4.4**.
  * *Market (Morning):* Kaisen-don (sea urchin, salmon roe, and crab rice bowl) at **Nijo Fish Market** (Donburi Chaya).
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,500 ($30) \| Hotel: ¥14,500 ($95) \| Transit: ¥1,200 ($8) \| Food: ¥6,500 ($43) → **Total: ~$176**

---

### Stop 2: Rakuten Mobile Park Miyagi (Sendai, Miyagi)
* **Date:** Thursday, June 25, 2026 *(Travel day June 24 / June 25 morning)*
* **Matchup:** Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles vs. Saitama Seibu Lions (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Rakuten Mobile Park Miyagi — Open-air natural grass ballpark with an outfield amusement park, Ferris wheel, and carousel.
* **Travel Leg:** Sapporo (CTS) to Sendai (SDJ) via **Peach Aviation / Air Do Nonstop Flight** (1 hr 10 min, ~$50 / ¥7,500). *Comparing options on Google Flights, this flight saves over 5 hours and ¥15,000 compared to the 6.5-hour train route.* Sendai Airport Access Line to Sendai Station (25 min, ¥660 / ~$4.40). Walk 15 min down Miyagino-dori or take Sendai Subway Tozai line to Miyagino-hara (¥210).
* **Accommodation:** **Hotel Metropolitan Sendai East** (Booking.com score: 9.0 Wonderful, connected to Sendai Station East Exit, ~$110/night; easy walk down Miyagino-dori to the park).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* Thick-cut charcoal-grilled beef tongue set with oxtail soup and barley rice at **Gyutan Tsukasa (牛タン焼専門店 司)** or **Date no Gyutan Honpo** on Sendai Station Gyutan-dori.
  * *Ballpark:* Sendai craft ale and local beef tongue skewers on the outfield concourse.
  * *Post-Game Izakaya:* **Robata Sendai** for Sanriku grilled seafood, seasonal oysters, and local Miyagi junmai sake (Ichinokura, Urakasumi).
  * *Local Sweet:* Zunda Shake & Zunda Mochi (sweet edamame paste) at **Zunda Saryo** in Sendai Station.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥3,800 ($25) \| Flight CTS-SDJ: ¥7,500 ($50) \| Hotel (2 nights Jun 24–25): ¥28,000 ($186) \| Transit: ¥1,500 ($10) \| Food: ¥11,000 ($73) → **Total: ~$344**

### Stop 3: Belluna Dome (Tokorozawa, Saitama)
* **Date:** Friday, June 26, 2026
* **Matchup:** Saitama Seibu Lions vs. Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Belluna Dome — Semi-open dome nestled in the green hills of Sayama with natural airflow and NPB's highest-ranked ballpark dining concourse.
* **Travel Leg:** Sendai Station to Omiya / Tokyo via **JR Tohoku Shinkansen (Hayabusa)** (1 hr 15 min to Omiya, ¥10,890 / ~$72). Seibu Sayama Line to Seibukyujo-mae Station (stops directly outside stadium gate, ¥500 / ~$3.30).
* **Accommodation:** **Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Ikebukuro** (Booking.com score: 8.6 Excellent, right at Ikebukuro Station—the direct terminus for the Seibu Ikebukuro line, ~$125/night) or **Kikusuitei** (score: 8.8, lakeside Japanese-style hotel by Sayama Lake).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* Handmade Saitama Musashino Udon (chewy noodles dipped in hot pork-and-dashi broth) at **Teuchi Udon Suzaki** or **Fukusuke**.
  * *Ballpark:* Lions Roast Beef Bowl, brick-oven pizza from Craft Beer Brewery Green Forest, and local Sayama green tea soft serve.
  * *Post-Game:* Late-night ramen at **Mutekiya** (Ikebukuro) or quick skewers at **Torikizoku**.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥3,800 ($25) \| Shinkansen: ¥10,890 ($72) \| Hotel: ¥18,500 ($125) \| Transit: ¥900 ($6) \| Food: ¥5,800 ($38) → **Total: ~$266**

---

### Stop 4: Meiji Jingu Stadium (Shinjuku / Gaienmae, Tokyo)
* **Date:** Saturday, June 27, 2026
* **Matchup:** Tokyo Yakult Swallows vs. Chunichi Dragons (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Meiji Jingu Stadium — Historic 1926 open-air cathedral in central Tokyo where Babe Ruth played, famous for Tokyo skyline views and mini-umbrella victory dances.
* **Travel Leg:** Tokyo Metro Ginza Line to Gaienmae Station (5 min walk) or JR Chuo-Sobu Line to Shinanomachi Station (10 min walk) (¥210 / ~$1.40).
* **Accommodation:** **HOTEL GROOVE SHINJUKU, A PARKROYAL Hotel** (Booking.com score: 9.1 Wonderful, Tokyu Kabukicho Tower, ~$145/night) or **Hotel Gracery Shinjuku** (score: 8.3 Very Good, ~$110/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* Rich fish-pork broth tsukemen at **Fuunji** (Shinjuku) or refreshing yuzu shio ramen at **AFURI Harajuku**.
  * *Ballpark:* The classic mega-platter "Jingu Winna Sausage" paired with draft beer from the stadium vendors, plus Yakult's signature Muranami beef bowl.
  * *Post-Game Izakaya:* Charcoal-grilled yakitori and highballs in the nostalgic showa-era alleys of **Omoide Yokocho** ("Memory Lane") in Shinjuku.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,200 ($28) \| Hotel: ¥19,500 ($130) \| Transit: ¥600 ($4) \| Food: ¥6,200 ($41) → **Total: ~$203**

---

### Stop 5: ZOZO Marine Stadium (Chiba / Makuhari, Chiba)
* **Date:** Sunday, June 28, 2026
* **Matchup:** Chiba Lotte Marines vs. Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks (17:00 Evening Game)
* **Stadium:** ZOZO Marine Stadium — Open-air stadium on Tokyo Bay celebrated for sea breezes, inning-break fireworks, and the loudest jumping cheer section in Japan.
* **Travel Leg:** Tokyo Station to Kaihimmakuhari Station via **JR Keiyo Line Rapid** (30 min, ¥580 / ~$3.80). 15-minute walk through Makuhari Seaside Park or 5-minute shuttle bus (¥100).
* **Accommodation:** **Hotel Francs** (Booking.com score: 8.2 Very Good, 0.2 mi from Kaihimmakuhari Station, ~$85/night) or **APA Hotel & Resort Tokyo Bay Makuhari** (score: 8.2, adjacent to stadium with hot springs, ~$90/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* High-grade fresh Edomae sushi sourcing directly from Chiba's Choshi Port at **Sushi Choushimaru Makuhari**.
  * *Ballpark:* The cult-favorite Marines Motsu-ni (slow-simmered miso beef tripe stew), Motsu Yakisoba, and Chiba peanut soft-serve ice cream.
  * *Post-Game:* Sashimi platters, steamed local clams, and draft beer at the Kaihimmakuhari Station plaza izakayas.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥3,600 ($24) \| Hotel: ¥13,500 ($90) \| Transit: ¥800 ($5) \| Food: ¥5,500 ($36) → **Total: ~$155**

### Stop 6: Tokyo Dome (Bunkyo, Tokyo)
* **Date:** Tuesday, June 30, 2026 *(Rest / Tokyo exploration day June 29)*
* **Matchup:** Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks vs. Saitama Seibu Lions (18:00 Night Game, Hawks Tokyo Dome Summer Festival)
* **Stadium:** Tokyo Dome ("The Big Egg") — Japan's most celebrated dome, host of the World Baseball Classic and the Japanese Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum.
* **Travel Leg:** JR Chuo-Sobu Line to Suidobashi Station or Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line to Korakuen Station (15 min, ¥230 / ~$1.50).
* **Accommodation:** **Tokyo Dome Hotel** (Booking.com score: 8.7 Excellent, located directly inside Tokyo Dome City, 0.2 mi from the gates, ~$140/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* Innovative duck and lamb broth ramen at **Mensho Tokyo** (Koishikawa / Suidobashi) or fresh nigiri sushi at **Tsukiji Outer Market**.
  * *Ballpark:* Player-curated bento boxes from the concourse, Giants/Hawks melon pan, and Tokyo Dome lemon sours.
  * *Post-Game:* Tokyo Dome City restaurant complex or a short walk to Kagurazaka for authentic izakaya dining and seasonal sake at **Toriyoshi**.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,800 ($32) \| Hotel (2 nights Jun 29–30): ¥38,000 ($250) \| Transit: ¥1,200 ($8) \| Food: ¥12,000 ($80) → **Total: ~$370**

### Stop 7: Yokohama Stadium (Yokohama / Kannai, Kanagawa)
* **Date:** Thursday, July 2, 2026 *(Rest / Yokohama day July 1)*
* **Matchup:** Yokohama DeNA BayStars vs. Hiroshima Toyo Carp (18:15 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Yokohama Stadium — Beautiful outdoor ballpark inside Yokohama Park, 2020 Olympic venue with signature steep deck seating.
* **Travel Leg:** Tokyo Station to Kannai Station via **JR Keihin-Tohoku Line** (35 min, ¥580 / ~$3.80). 2-minute walk from Kannai Station South Exit.
* **Accommodation:** **Daiwa Roynet Hotel Yokohama-Koen** (Booking.com score: 8.8 Excellent, located 0.1 mi directly across the street from the stadium gates, ~$85/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* **Yokohama Chinatown (Chukagai)** (5 min walk from stadium) for soup dumplings (xiaolongbao) at **Wangfujing** and dim sum at **Manchinro**.
  * *Ballpark:* BayStars Original Craft Beers ("BayStars Ale" and "BayStars Lager"), BayStars Fried Chicken, and Mikan Hyouketsu (frozen mandarin cup).
  * *Late Night:* Pilgrimage to **Yoshimuraya (吉村家)** near Yokohama Station—the legendary birthplace of Yokohama Iekei Ramen (rich tonkotsu-shoyu broth, spinach, nori, and chashu).
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,000 ($26) \| Hotel (2 nights Jul 1–2): ¥26,000 ($172) \| Transit: ¥1,500 ($10) \| Food: ¥11,000 ($73) → **Total: ~$281**

### Stop 8: Vantelin Dome Nagoya (Nagoya, Aichi)
* **Date:** Friday, July 3, 2026
* **Matchup:** Chunichi Dragons vs. Yomiuri Giants (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Vantelin Dome Nagoya — Chunichi Dragons' home dome with a massive LED panoramic screen and enthusiastic fan culture.
* **Travel Leg:** Shin-Yokohama to Nagoya Station via **JR Tokaido Shinkansen (Nozomi)** (1 hr 17 min, ¥10,120 non-reserved / ~$67). Transfer to JR Chuo Line to Ozone Station (12 min) or Nagoya Subway Meijo Line to Nagoya Dome-mae Yada Station (direct underground concourse, ¥270 / ~$1.80).
* **Accommodation:** **Nagoya JR Gate Tower Hotel** (Booking.com score: 8.9 Excellent, right atop Nagoya Station, ~$115/night) or **Daiwa Roynet Hotel Nagoya Taiko-dori** (~$80/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* **Atsuta Horaiken (あつた蓬莱軒)** — 150-year-old master of Nagoya Hitsumabushi (charcoal-grilled unagi served over rice in three distinct steps: plain, with wasabi/nori, and as dashi ochazuke).
  * *Afternoon:* Traditional Nagoya "Morning/Tea Service" with Ogura toast (sweet red bean paste on thick buttered toast) at **Komeda's Coffee**.
  * *Ballpark:* Dragons Miso Katsu skewers, Doteyaki (beef tendon simmered in red Hatcho miso), and Nagoya draft beer.
  * *Post-Game Izakaya:* Crispy, peppery fried chicken wings (Tebasaki) with highballs at **Sekai no Yamachan** or **Furaibou**.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,000 ($26) \| Shinkansen: ¥10,120 ($67) \| Hotel: ¥17,500 ($115) \| Transit: ¥800 ($5) \| Food: ¥7,500 ($50) → **Total: ~$263**

### Stop 9: Hanshin Koshien Stadium (Nishinomiya, Hyogo / Kansai)
* **Date:** Saturday, July 4, 2026
* **Matchup:** Hanshin Tigers vs. Hiroshima Toyo Carp (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Hanshin Koshien Stadium — The sacred cathedral of Japanese baseball (built 1924), home of high school tournaments, ivy-covered brick exterior, and the most passionate fans in Japan.
* **Travel Leg:** Nagoya to Shin-Osaka via **JR Tokaido Shinkansen** (50 min, ¥5,940 / ~$40) or Kintetsu Limited Express Hinotori to Osaka-Namba (2h 05m, ¥4,990). Hanshin Main Line Express from Osaka-Umeda to Koshien Station (16 min, ¥280 / ~$1.90).
* **Accommodation:** **Hotel Hewitt Koshien** (Booking.com score: 8.3 Very Good, 0.2 mi / 2 min walk from Koshien Stadium and Station, ~$95/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Pre-Game:* Soak up the festive Tigers fan street stalls outside Koshien Station with piping takoyaki and tiger-themed snacks.
  * *Ballpark Gourmet:* Koshien's legendary holy trinity: 1) **Koshien Curry** (simmered recipe since 1924), 2) **Koshien Jumbo Yakisoba** cooked on massive griddles, and 3) freshly grilled Koshien Yakitori.
  * *Late Night:* Sannomiya / Kobe Beef burger or casual Kansai craft beer bars in Umeda.
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,500 ($30) \| Shinkansen: ¥5,940 ($40) \| Hotel: ¥14,500 ($95) \| Transit: ¥700 ($5) \| Food: ¥6,500 ($43) → **Total: ~$213**

---

### Stop 10: Kyocera Dome Osaka (Osaka, Osaka)
* **Date:** Sunday, July 5, 2026
* **Matchup:** Orix Buffaloes vs. Saitama Seibu Lions (14:00 Afternoon Game)
* **Stadium:** Kyocera Dome Osaka — Striking flying-saucer domed ballpark in central Osaka, home of the Pacific League power Orix Buffaloes.
* **Travel Leg:** Hanshin Namba Line direct from Koshien to Dome-mae Station (stops right underneath Kyocera Dome, 15 min, ¥310 / ~$2.00).
* **Accommodation:** **Toyoko Inn Osaka Dome Mae** (Booking.com score: 8.3 Very Good, 0.1 mi from Kyocera Dome, ~$75/night) or **Candeo Hotels Osaka Namba** (~$110/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Ballpark:* Buffaloes Kobe Beef bento box, Osaka-style karaage chicken, and Orix blue cocktails.
  * *Dinner (Dotonbori & Shinsekai "Kuidaore" Tour):*
    * **Takoyaki Wanaka Sennichimae** for piping-hot octopus balls with crispy exterior and dashi-rich interior.
    * **Mizuno Dotonbori** (Michelin-listed) for savory Yamaimo cabbage okonomiyaki.
    * **Kushikatsu Daruma** in Shinsekai for crunchy deep-fried skewered meats and vegetables (strict "no double-dipping" rule).
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥3,800 ($25) \| Hotel: ¥12,500 ($82) \| Transit: ¥600 ($4) \| Food: ¥7,000 ($46) → **Total: ~$157**

### Stop 11: MAZDA Zoom-Zoom Stadium Hiroshima (Hiroshima)
* **Date:** Tuesday, July 7, 2026 *(Travel day July 6, visit Miyajima & Peace Memorial)*
* **Matchup:** Hiroshima Toyo Carp vs. Tokyo Yakult Swallows (18:00 Night Game)
* **Stadium:** MAZDA Zoom-Zoom Stadium Hiroshima — American-style asymmetrical open-air ballpark with natural turf, an MLB-inspired wide concourse, and a passionate sea of red-clad Carp fans.
* **Travel Leg:** Shin-Osaka to Hiroshima Station via **JR Sanyo Shinkansen (Sakura / Nozomi)** (1 hr 25 min, ¥9,890 non-reserved / ~$66). The stadium is an easy 10-minute festive walk down "Carp Road" directly from Hiroshima Station South Exit.
* **Accommodation:** **Hotel Granvia Hiroshima** (Booking.com score: 8.8 Excellent, directly connected to Hiroshima Shinkansen Station, 0.1 mi, ~$95/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Lunch:* Layered Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki packed with cabbage, yakisoba noodles, pork belly, egg, and Otafuku sauce at **Okonomimura** or **Okonomiyaki Nagata-ya** near Peace Park.
  * *Regional Specialty:* Grilled Hiroshima oysters (kaki) with lemon and ponzu at Ekie food hall inside Hiroshima Station.
  * *Ballpark:* **Carp Udon** (served at Carp home games since 1957 with shrimp tempura and sweet fried tofu), Carp red draft beer, and chashu bowls.
  * *Miyajima Snack:* Fresh warm Momiji Manju (maple leaf cakes filled with sweet bean or custard) and grilled conger eel (anago meshi).
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,000 ($26) \| Shinkansen: ¥9,890 ($66) \| Hotel (2 nights Jul 6–7): ¥28,000 ($186) \| Transit: ¥1,500 ($10) \| Food: ¥12,000 ($80) → **Total: ~$368**

### Stop 12: Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka (Fukuoka, Kyushu)
* **Date:** Friday, July 10, 2026 *(Travel / rest days July 8–9 exploring Hakata & Kyushu)*
* **Matchup:** Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks vs. Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles (18:00 Grand Finale Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka — Giant waterfront retractable-dome stadium on Hakata Bay, famous for multimedia laser shows, roof-opening celebrations, and the powerhouse SoftBank Hawks.
* **Travel Leg:** Hiroshima Station to Hakata (Fukuoka) via **JR Sanyo Shinkansen** (1 hr 05 min, ¥8,570 non-reserved / ~$57; Kodama discount tickets available from ~¥6,500). Fukuoka Subway Kuko Line from Hakata to Tojinmachi Station (11 min, ¥260), then 12-minute walk to the Dome.
* **Accommodation:** **Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk** (Booking.com score: 8.6 Excellent, oceanfront resort hotel directly connected to PayPay Dome, ~$145/night) or **Richmond Hotel Fukuoka Tenjin** (~$85/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Ballpark:* Hawks Player Bento, Hakata mentaiko cheese dogs, and post-game victory fireworks inside the dome.
  * *Tonkotsu Ramen Tour:* **Hakata Isshin (博多一双)** (famed for its frothy "pork bone cappuccino" rich broth) or **Hakata Ramen Shin-Shin** in Tenjin.
  * *Late Night Yatai Tour:* **Nakasu Yatai** street food stalls along the river canal for grilled pork skewers, bite-sized pan-fried Hakata gyoza (**Tetsunabe**), and hot ramen side-by-side with locals.
  * *Regional Hotpot:* **Hakata Motsunabe** (tender beef intestine and cabbage hotpot in garlic-shoyu dashi) at **Motsunabe Yamanaka**.
* **Return Flight:** Fukuoka Airport (FUK) to Tokyo Haneda (HND) via **Skymark Airlines / StarFlyer / ANA** (1 hr 40 min nonstop, ~$65 / ¥9,800). *Comparing Google Flights, this saves 3.5 hours and over ¥13,000 compared to the 5-hour Shinkansen back to Tokyo.*
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,800 ($32) \| Shinkansen: ¥8,570 ($57) \| Return Flight FUK-HND: ¥9,800 ($65) \| Hotel (3 nights Jul 8–10): ¥42,000 ($278) \| Transit: ¥1,800 ($12) \| Food: ¥18,000 ($120) → **Total: ~$564**

Walk 15 min down Miyagino-dori or take Sendai Subway Tozai line to Miyagino-hara (¥210).

### Stop 12: Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka (Fukuoka, Kyushu)
* **Date:** Friday, July 10, 2026 *(Travel / rest days July 8–9 exploring Hakata & Kyushu)*
* **Matchup:** Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks vs. Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles (18:00 Grand Finale Night Game)
* **Stadium:** Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka — Giant waterfront retractable-dome stadium on Hakata Bay, famous for multimedia laser shows, roof-opening celebrations, and the powerhouse SoftBank Hawks.
* **Travel Leg:** Hiroshima Station to Hakata (Fukuoka) via **JR Sanyo Shinkansen** (1 hr 05 min, ¥8,570 non-reserved / ~$57; Kodama discount tickets available from ~¥6,500). Fukuoka Subway Kuko Line from Hakata to Tojinmachi Station (11 min, ¥260), then 12-minute walk to the Dome.
* **Accommodation:** **Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk** (Booking.com score: 8.6 Excellent, oceanfront resort hotel directly connected to PayPay Dome, ~$145/night) or **Richmond Hotel Fukuoka Tenjin** (~$85/night).
* **Food Plan:**
  * *Ballpark:* Hawks Player Bento, Hakata mentaiko cheese dogs, and post-game victory fireworks inside the dome.
  * *Tonkotsu Ramen Tour:* **Hakata Isshin (博多一双)** (famed for its frothy "pork bone cappuccino" rich broth) or **Hakata Ramen Shin-Shin** in Tenjin.
  * *Late Night Yatai Tour:* **Nakasu Yatai** street food stalls along the river canal for grilled pork skewers, bite-sized pan-fried Hakata gyoza (**Tetsunabe**), and hot ramen side-by-side with locals.

* **Return Flight:** Fukuoka Airport (FUK) to Tokyo Haneda (HND) via **Skymark Airlines / StarFlyer / ANA** (1 hr 40 min nonstop, ~$65 / ¥9,800). *Comparing Google Flights, this saves 3.5 hours and over ¥13,000 compared to the 5-hour Shinkansen back to Tokyo.*
* **Estimated Cost for Stop:** Ticket: ¥4,800 ($32) \| Shinkansen: ¥8,570 ($57) \| Return Flight FUK-HND: ¥9,800 ($65) \| Hotel (3 nights Jul 8–10): ¥42,000 ($278) \| Transit: ¥1,800 ($12) \| Food: ¥18,000 ($120) → **Total: ~$564**
